She is {{an|Kiawe}}'s younger sister and the daughter of [[Sima]] and [[Rango]]. ==History== [[File:Kiawe and Mimo.png|left|thumb|250px|Mimo and Kiawe]] Mimo debuted in ''[[SM011|Young Kiawe Had a Farm!]]'', at her family's home at [[Paniola Ranch]]. She reappeared in ''[[SM023|Getting the Band Back Together!]]'', where she attended a concert hosted by [[DJ Leo]]. In ''[[SM026|So Long, Sophocles!]]'', Mimo assisted {{ashcl|the group}} in preparing a farewell party for {{an|Sophocles}} when it seemed like he was moving away. In ''[[SM030|The Ol' Raise and Switch!]]'', Mimo had some fun playing with {{TP|Lana|Popplio}}, which Kiawe was looking after. She later warned him that two of the {{p|Tauros}} were fighting, and watched as Popplio helped calm them down. In ''[[SM070|The Young Flame Strikes Back!]]'', the future of the ranch came under threat of being turned into a hotel by a businessman named [[Viren]]. Mimo stood up to Viren, only to be targeted by {{p|Electivire}}'s {{m|Thunder}}. {{TP|Kiawe|Turtonator}} and {{TP|Kiawe|Marowak}} stepped in to defend her, which resulted in Turtonator being knocked out. She later stood up to Viren the next day, only for Viren and [[Viren's henchmen|his henchmen]] to be arrested by [[Officer Jenny]] for forging land owner documents. In ''[[SM081|A Young Royal Flame Ignites!]]'', Mimo watched the [[Battle Royal]] along with Kiawe and {{TP|Kiawe|Marowak}}. Mimo appeared during a flashback in ''[[SM087|Filling the Light with Darkness!]]'', where Kiawe revealed that he and his sister were working on the farm whilst Rango and Sima were sleeping, due to the effects of {{an|Necrozma}} draining the [[Z-Power|Ultra Aura]] from the [[region]]. In ''[[SM091|A Plethora of Pikachu!]]'', Mimo visited [[Pikachu Valley]] with Ash and Kiawe. In ''[[SM093|Lillier and the Staff!]]'', Mimo watched Kiawe perform in the school play. In ''[[SM103|Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!]]'', Ash and his classmates visited Paniola Ranch alongside {{an|Brock}} and {{an|Misty}}. Mimo provided them with some ice cream and watched as Brock helped treat a baby {{p|Kangaskhan}} who had been threatening some {{p|Miltank}}. In ''[[SM110|Keeping Your Eyes on the Ball!]]'', Mimo watched [[Kahili]] play a round of PokéGolf on TV. In ''[[SM123|A Fiery Training Camp Trick!]]'', Mimo wanted to go camping with Kiawe, Sophocles, and Ash, only for Sima to say they weren't going camping for fun. Mimo later visited the camp alongside Sima to provide food to the boys. In ''[[SM135|The Final Four!]]'', Mimo arrived at [[Manalo Stadium]] to cheer Kiawe on during his battle against {{an|Gladion}}. On her way there, she confronted [[Tupp]], [[Zipp]], and [[Rapp]], who were spray-painting graffiti on the floors, only for them to send out their Pokémon. She was saved by Gladion and his {{TP|Gladion|Silvally}}, who took her to Kiawe. Mimo later sat with Kiawe's classmates in the stands and watched the battle between Kiawe and Gladion, cheering her brother on. In ''[[SM136|Getting Down to The Ire!]]'', Mimo continued to watch Kiawe's battle against Gladion, and observed as her brother lost. The [[Poké Problem]] segment revealed Mimo had begun to admire Gladion while heading home on a boat with her father. ==Character== Mimo is always keen to help out around the farm and gets annoyed with Kiawe whenever he stops her from lifting heavy objects, as he is concerned about her safety. She also views Kiawe as overprotective, but she still loves him a lot. Mimo is supportive of Kiawe, as seen in ''[[SM135|The Final Four!]]'', when she visited [[Manalo Stadium]] to cheer Kiawe during his battle against {{an|Gladion}}. Despite this, it seems that Mimo has a secret crush on Gladion.Confirmed in the [[Poké Problem#List of Poké Problem segments|extra scene]] of ''[[SM136|Getting Down to The Ire!]]''. Mimo is also close to [[Kiawe's Turtonator]], as seen in ''[[SM070|The Young Flame Strikes Back!]]''; after Turtonator got knocked out protecting her from {{p|Electivire}}'s {{m|Thunder}} attack, Mimo was crying over it and even called it Turty. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{fire color light}}|bordercolor={{fire color dark}} |ja=渋谷彩乃 ''[[Ayano Shibuya]]'' |en=[[Simona Berman]] |it=Valentina Pallavicino ([[SM011]])
